scope: Root pre-response interpretation notes. Root has historical task context; these are independent reasoning notes, not a fully blinded expert assessment.

comparison_rule: The extra spreadsheet operand is the primary unambiguous defective-item endpoint. Report other interpretation concerns separately from clear defects.
